arcane-archer: A ranged caster who fights with INT, enchants arrows on the fly and fires spells straight through the bow.
assassin: Strikes from stealth or the flank for heavy crits, then slips back into hiding mid-fight.
captain: A battlefield leader who spends Inspiration Points to hasten, empower and protect allies.
lurker: Waits for enemies to act first, then punishes anyone whose turn has already passed.
magus: A staff caster whose spells reach further, cover more ground and can crit without an attack roll.
marksman: Gives up movement for accuracy, guards lanes with Overwatch and hits harder from high ground.
sage: A concentration caster who swaps spells mid-fight, converts damage types and upgrades spells for free.
samurai: Flows between four sword stances, each grown with its own Bushido skills.
sentinel: A shield-bearer who hardens nearby allies, takes hits meant for them and taunts enemies away.
skirmisher: Moves and acts outside their own turn, cutting into the initiative order with extra movement and actions.
spellblade: A melee caster who fights with INT, enchants their blade and spends Spellstrike Points on magical strikes.
spellslinger: A rapid caster who bends action costs, spends Alacrity Points to cast faster and is rewarded for variety.
